xiava_lake.name: Xiava's Lake
xiava_lake.description: A vast mist-covered lake and the wild lands around it, where soulbeasts are born. A later region. Passage is granted by treaty with the Veylwood Concord, and only to the holders of a Xiava Writ: the Royal Ember Academy and two sects.

sects.name: Royal Ember Academy of Kingsreach
sects.description: The crown's academy. Nobles' children, scholarship commoners and scouted talents study arms, arts, law and command together. Graduates fill the officer corps and the Council of Wardens.

entry_requirements.test: Three trials: an affinity reading at the Ember Stone, a sparring bout, a written examination.
entry_requirements.scholarship: Waived for anyone recommended by an academy talent scout.

sects.soulbeast_rite: Top students of the Flame Senior year travel with instructors to Xiava's Lake to seek a soulbeast bond.

sects.name: Ninefold Sword Pavilion
sects.description: The oldest and proudest sect of the peaks. Its nine sword-forms each take a decade to master. It holds one of the two sect Xiava Writs and sends a small expedition each spring.

entry_requirements.test: Climb the Nine Thousand Steps in one day, then hold a sword stance at the summit until dawn.

sects.name: Iron Lotus Monastery
sects.description: Monks who temper the body until it rings like a bell. They take anyone who arrives at the gate and survives three winters of chores.

entry_requirements.test: Three winters of servant work; those who leave are not asked back.

sects.name: Greywatch Spear Hall
sects.description: A frontier school founded by a retired marshal. It teaches Stonesetting spear-work to farm children and soldiers alike; the Runeward Legion recruits from its best.

entry_requirements.test: Hold the Rooted Stance for an hour while senior students push.

sects.name: Old Mill Staff Yard
sects.description: Behind Ashford's old mill a one-armed veteran, Maren Coldbrook, teaches village children to fight with a quarterstaff. Humble, but she was once a Runeward officer and she notices talent.

entry_requirements.test: Chop a week of her firewood without complaint.

sects.name: Hall of the Four Currents
sects.description: The islands' school of elemental arts. It teaches that every element is a current and that a master can learn to feel all four, though most students are bound to one.

entry_requirements.test: Move a bowl of water without touching it, by any element.

sects.name: School of the Hollow Moon
sects.description: A hidden school on a fog-bound islet that trains the Veiled Lanterns. Officially it does not exist. Students learn Stormstitch flash-steps, disguise, poisons and silence.

entry_requirements.test: Unknown. Candidates are chosen, never apply; most are orphans or younger children of retainer houses.

sects.name: Verdant Oath Sanctuary
sects.description: Keepers of the old road to Xiava's Lake. Their disciples bond with beasts through Rootsong; the finest are guided to the lake to meet a soulbeast. They admit a handful of outsiders each decade.

entry_requirements.test: Spend a night alone in the Deep Grove; a wild beast must choose to approach you.

sects.name: Seminary of the Dawnflame
sects.description: Where Solmarch trains its priests and paladins. Students learn Flamecanting and the white Dawnflame; the best are ordained into the Paladin Orders.

entry_requirements.test: Hold one's hand over the cathedral brazier while reciting the Litany of Dawn.

sects.name: Windstep Riders' Lodge
sects.description: The travelling lodge where Ongur youth learn Windstriding. Its lodge-masters ride with the Great Khan's camp, and anyone who can keep up may join.

entry_requirements.test: Ride from dawn to dusk behind the lodge herd without falling behind.

sects.name: Brotherhood of the Anvil
sects.description: Half forge-guild, half fighting school. Apprentices learn to make a weapon before they may learn to use it.

entry_requirements.test: Forge a nail that the guildmaster cannot bend.
